children: Trane Technologies said it agreed to acquire Cancoil Thermal, a maker of heat-transfer products.

Cancoil Thermal, based in Ontario, Canada, is known for its ability to design and build products customized for customer needs, Trane said. The company's products include fluid coolers, air-cooled condensers and custom finned-tube coils.

The acquisition includes Cancoil's existing operations, manufacturing facilities in Ontario, and manufacturing operations in Jacksonville, Texas. The deal also includes Trane acquiring a team of over 450 employees, it said.
The deal is expected to close before the end of the year, and financial terms were not disclosed.
Trane is a manufacturer of heating and air-conditioning systems.
